blocks.raw: # View and Organize Dataflows
blocks.text: View and Organize Dataflows

blocks.raw: The Connect+ UI provides search, filter, and tag options to help you organize dataflows within your organization.
blocks.text: The Connect+ UI provides search, filter, and tag options to help you organize dataflows within your organization.

blocks.raw: ## View dataflows
blocks.text: View dataflows

blocks.raw: You can view all created dataflows on the Connect+ home page. Search for dataflows by name or filter them using tags.
blocks.text: You can view all created dataflows on the Connect+ home page. Search for dataflows by name or filter them using tags.

blocks.raw: ## Organize dataflows using tags
blocks.text: Organize dataflows using tags

blocks.raw: A tag is a label used to categorize dataflows. It helps you group and easily locate related dataflows.
blocks.text: A tag is a label used to categorize dataflows. It helps you group and easily locate related dataflows.

blocks.raw: For example, you can assign the tag `Transaction` to all dataflows related to the transaction entity, making them easier to identify and manage.
blocks.text: For example, you can assign the tag Transaction to all dataflows related to the transaction entity, making them easier to identify and manage.

blocks.raw: A tag can be associated with multiple dataflows, but each dataflow can have only one tag. The maximum length of a tag is 15 characters.
blocks.text: A tag can be associated with multiple dataflows, but each dataflow can have only one tag. The maximum length of a tag is 15 characters.

blocks.raw: To assign a tag, enter a label in the **Tags** field when creating or editing a dataflow in the `Draft` state.
blocks.text: To assign a tag, enter a label in the Tags field when creating or editing a dataflow in the Draft state.

blocks.raw: ## Search and filter dataflows
blocks.text: Search and filter dataflows

blocks.raw: Use the search and filter options on the dataflow listing page to find specific dataflows. You can use text search, tags, or both.
blocks.text: Use the search and filter options on the dataflow listing page to find specific dataflows. You can use text search, tags, or both.

blocks.raw:
Use **Text search** to enter the full or partial name of a dataflow in the search bar.
Use **Tag** to select a tag from the filter options and view only the dataflows associated with that tag.
blocks.text:
Use Text search to enter the full or partial name of a dataflow in the search bar.
Use Tag to select a tag from the filter options and view only the dataflows associated with that tag.

blocks.raw: ## View dataflow versions
blocks.text: View dataflow versions

blocks.raw: Connect+ dataflows are version-controlled. When you create a dataflow, it starts as version v1 in the `Draft` state.
blocks.text: Connect+ dataflows are version-controlled. When you create a dataflow, it starts as version v1 in the Draft state.

blocks.raw: When a [version is approved](https://docs.capillarytech.com/docs/creating-and-managing-connect-dataflows#review-and-approve-a-dataflow), the system automatically creates the next version with an incremented number. The new version starts in the `Draft` state and is a copy of the approved version, ready for further updates.
blocks.text: When a version is approved, the system automatically creates the next version with an incremented number. The new version starts in the Draft state and is a copy of the approved version, ready for further updates.

blocks.raw: ### Compare versions
blocks.text: Compare versions

blocks.raw: You can compare code changes between any two versions of a dataflow.
blocks.text: You can compare code changes between any two versions of a dataflow.

blocks.raw:
1. In the dataflow canvas, click the version compare icon.
   The compare versions window opens.

   <Image align="center" border={true} src="https://files.readme.io/36e8ef7488fb785e55079a261f3c6ed89b688b213bc0fbe0f14d0bcaa79b6461-Screenshot_2026-04-13_at_4.54.22_PM.png" className="border" />
2. Use the drop-down to select the two versions you want to compare.

   <Image align="center" border={true} src="https://files.readme.io/09d1d7ec37c221ce997dc5a400fd67af86ee485ee1d3caeaad08618fae58f01c-Screenshot_2026-04-13_at_4.56.33_PM.png" className="border" />

blocks.raw: ### Restore a version
blocks.text: Restore a version

blocks.raw: You can revert the current dataflow version to the most recently approved version.
blocks.text: You can revert the current dataflow version to the most recently approved version.

blocks.raw:
1. In the dataflow canvas, click the restore version icon.
   A Revert Rule modal appears.

3. Click **Yes**.

blocks.raw: ## Sync config updates
blocks.text: Sync config updates

blocks.raw: When config values are updated in [Extension Configurations](https://docs.capillarytech.com/docs/extension-configuration), you don't need to update each block individually. The sync option pulls the latest values from Extension Configurations to the dataflow in a single step, including updated credentials.
blocks.text: When config values are updated in Extension Configurations, you don't need to update each block individually. The sync option pulls the latest values from Extension Configurations to the dataflow in a single step, including updated credentials.

blocks.raw:
1. Open the dataflow in `Live` status.
2. Click the sync icon in the top-right corner of the canvas.\
   The **Sync Configuration** panel opens.

   <Image align="center" border={true} src="https://files.readme.io/33fccb66cdc242b5697c09c2bd3a2c7ad80b3abb390cc44b10b8c6527d9f420f-Sync-canvas.png" className="border" />
3. Review the difference between **Current Config** on the left and **Config Manager (latest)** on the right. Fields marked **CHANGED** show values that have been updated in Extension Configurations.

   <Image align="center" border={true} src="https://files.readme.io/7530054134775c5cb867ad8dea77a322fb1782adb27c7710426c81379944c268-sync-diff.png" className="border" />
4. Click **Sync**.\
   A confirmation dialog appears.
5. Click **Sync now**.\
   The dataflow applies the latest values across all blocks without restarting.

   <Image align="center" border={true} src="https://files.readme.io/44641ff18e254c067cb008bb81fa8a9130908cac785794fb36ddb90d2845a81f-confirm-syncnow.png" className="border" />
